title: Strict gates have arguments
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Boolean circuit in which every gate has distinct arguments and has exactly one argument if it is a NOT gate, and exactly two arguments otherwise. Suppose every vertex other than the output has positive fan-out. Then every gate has a nonempty argument list.
hypotheses_covered: Each NOT gate has exactly one argument and each other gate exactly two
Every vertex below the circuit size other than the output has positive fan-out
